proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  refine ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)], ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have h2 : (a - b) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
    have h3 : (b - c) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
    have h4 : a - b = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 h2
    have h5 : b - c = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 h3
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    ring
target_source: ∀ a b c : ℝ, a * b + b * c + c * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ∧ (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = a * b + b * c + c * a ↔ a = b ∧ b = c)
